titulo: I do, I go out, I put
intro: Learn the irregular yo forms of everyday verbs: hago, salgo, pongo and more.
b1.titulo: Verbs with an irregular yo form
b1.texto:
In the present tense, several very common verbs change only in the **yo** form:

| Verb | yo | tú |
|---|---|---|
| hacer | **hago** | haces |
| salir | **salgo** | sales |
| poner | **pongo** | pones |
| traer | **traigo** | traes |
| dar | **doy** | das |
| ver | **veo** | ves |
| decir | **digo** | dices |
| oír | **oigo** | oyes |

**Hacer** means both do and make: hago los deberes, hago la cena. **Poner la mesa** is to lay the table. **Salir de** is to leave a place; **salir con** is to go out with someone.

**Tener** and **venir** also have a g in the yo form: **tengo**, **vengo**.
b2.f0.texto: What do you do at weekends?
b2.f1.texto: On Saturdays I go out with my friends.
b4.texto: In these sentences the verbs have the irregular **yo** form: **salgo**, **oigo**, **hago**. The pronoun **yo** can often be dropped, but here it is kept to show who does the action. With a negative, Spanish keeps both words: **no hago nada**.
b4.e1.texto: I listen to music and do my homework.
b5.f0.texto: On Sundays I lay the table on the terrace at home.
b5.f1.texto: I bring fresh bread from the bakery on my street.
b5.f2.texto: My sister makes a very good coffee for the two of us.
b5.f3.texto: Afterwards I go out with her for a walk in the green park.
b5.f4.texto: In the afternoon I watch TV with my sister in the living room.
b5.f5.texto: I don't do anything important until night.
b5.f6.texto: She listens to soft music with headphones.
b5.f7.texto: At night I thank my sister for the coffee.
b6.pregunta: Complete: I go out with my friends.
b6.frase: ___ I go out with my friends.
b6.o1.refuerzo: The yo form adds a g: salgo, not salo.
b6.o2.refuerzo: Sale is for él or ella.
b7.pregunta: Complete: I do my homework at home.
b7.frase: ___ I do my homework at home.
b7.o1.refuerzo: The yo form is hago, not haco.
b7.o2.refuerzo: Hace is for él or ella.
b8.pregunta: Which pair is right for poner?
b8.o0.refuerzo: Correct! Only yo takes the g.
b9.pregunta: Translate into Spanish: «I don't do anything.»
b10.traduccion: On Saturdays I go out with my friends.
b10.frase: On Saturdays I go out with my friends.
p.hago.consejo: Yo form of hacer. Note the g: hago, haces, hace.
p.salgo.consejo: Yo form of salir. Salir de = leave a place; salir con = go out with someone.
p.pongo.consejo: Yo form of poner. Poner la mesa = to lay the table.
p.traigo.consejo: Yo form of traer. It adds an i and a g: traigo.
p.doy.consejo: Yo form of dar. It ends in -oy, like soy, voy and estoy.
p.veo.consejo: Yo form of ver. It has no g: veo.
p.digo.consejo: Yo form of decir. It also changes e to i: dices, dice.
p.oigo.consejo: Yo form of oír. The other forms are oyes, oye.
p.la tele.consejo: Short, informal form of la televisión.
p.con.consejo: Con + person: salgo con mis amigos.
p.nada.consejo: After the verb it needs no: no hago nada.
